run_reference_path_example: run the reference_path_example function to navigate an agent along a ground truth reference path in Habitat
run_save_map: run the save_map function to concatenate RGB observations with a top-down map and instruction text
run_shortest_path_follower: run the ShortestPathFollower to get the next navigation action toward a target point in the simulation
run_images_to_video: run the images_to_video utility to render a list of numpy image arrays into a video file
run_draw_top_down_map: run the draw_top_down_map function to generate a top-down map visualization from environment info
